message: docopt has to be built from source (its index has only a source distribution), but installer.only-binary in poetry.toml forbids building, so installing it fails until it is allowed
fix: Review docopt and add "pypi:docopt" to installScripts.allow in depcurfew.json (it is then always built from source), or replace the package

message: local-lib is built from source when installed (it is a local directory), which runs its build code: installer.only-binary in poetry.toml forbids building only for packages from an index, and depcurfew.json does not allow it
fix: Review local-lib and add "pypi:local-lib" to installScripts.allow in depcurfew.json (it is then always built from source), or replace the package
